# `SecondView`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Function-state notification of the view function in the auxiliary (wide) imager process.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, get_proc_view_name @0x3c19c0, DevInit callbacks @0x117cd0, ViewFunc @0x3c5a10 (64-bit build) |

The process-dependent view-name table maps 0 to SecondView and 1 to View; the auxiliary process names its view detail SecondView. It is emitted on channel W (TCP 4702) and the main imager forwards the unchanged line onto I (TCP 4700), so a 4700 client sees it too. Function-state family (F): the event formatter formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. Members beyond the F set come from the stage formatter installed on the detail (star-view formatter: mode, cam_id, target fields, gain; RTSP/view formatter: manual_exp, planet_correction, scan_planet_tip); which ones appear depends on the stage and camera, so all are optional. Child function states (AutoFocus, AutoGoto, Stack and so on) are nested only in the full function-tree print of iscope_get_app_state / get_view_state, not in a standalone event; they send their own events. Do not expect the main-only gain/target members; the exact set of auxiliary-only stage transitions is unresolved. Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 consumes it.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SecondView"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | F state table; unknown internal codes fall back to idle. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (F formatter) | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (F formatter) | - | Stored error code; present at fail even when zero. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. [READ] |
| `mode` | string | no | - | View mode name from the view-name table (star, scenery, moon, sun, planet, solar_sys, none; fallback unknown). Solar-system ids serialize as solar_sys with target_type naming the body. [READ] |
| `target_type` | string | if solar-system view modes | - | Solar-system mode only: moon, sun or planet; unknown fallback. [READ] |
| `cam_id` | integer | no | - | Camera id; no enumeration established. [READ] |
| `star_type` | integer | if stored star_type >= 0 | - | Only when the stored star type is non-negative; enum not established. [READ] |
| `target_name` | string | if target name non-empty | - | Only when the target name is non-empty. [READ] |
| `target_ra_dec` | array<number> | if both coordinates set | - | Two numbers when both stored coordinates differ from the -999 sentinel. Order INFERRED RA, Dec; units and epoch are method-dependent (see get_view_state). Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `lp_filter` | boolean | no | - | Target light-pollution filter flag (INFERRED meaning). [READ] |
| `gain` | integer | if gain control read succeeds | - | Only when the camera gain control read succeeds; scale unresolved. [READ] |
| `manual_exp` | boolean | no | - | From the view RTSP formatter. [READ] |
| `planet_correction` | boolean | no | - | From the view RTSP formatter. [READ] |
| `scan_planet_tip` | boolean | no | - | From the view RTSP formatter. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Wide view running (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"SecondView","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":8200,"mode":"star","cam_id":1,"lp_filter":false}
```
